title: Portia Page Target
description: Version-1 Portia pre-print operational target for one logical page within a Capture Batch. It preserves the exact intended capture purpose, historical template/layout identity, expected interpretation mode, stable page-local entry layout, and optional exact existing Portia context needed to interpret a returned page later. A Core PDS2 RouteRegistration may target this record before printing. The Page Target is not a printed-copy identity, returned-page identity, retained source, machine interpretation, proposal, review decision, or canonical behavior-domain record.
$comment: Core route registration remains authoritative for route_id, payload/signature state, and immutable route metadata. Page Target semantic fields are Portia-owned and must exist before route registration/QR rendering rather than being reconstructed from Core module_details. Application validation is responsible for Capture Batch existence/class agreement, Core RouteRegistration target agreement, registration-before-render, exact context resolution, purpose/context compatibility, template/layout availability and fingerprint agreement, lifecycle/correction rules, authorization, and preventing Page Targets from being treated as evidence or domain facts.

x-portia-application-invariants.description: The owning Capture Batch must exist and agree exactly with class_id/work_id; page_index uniqueness is enforced within the rendering workflow where required.

Any Core RouteRegistration used for this page must identify module_id portia and the same class_id/work_id, and its target must be record_kind capture_page_target with this exact page_target_id and supported non-null contract version.
QR/PDS2 rendering is permitted only after an exact active Core RouteRegistration has been created and verified for this Page Target.

Rendering and later interpretation must use the exact template_id/template_version/layout_version/capture_spec_version/layout_fingerprint/page_role/page_ordinal represented here; current-installed-template substitution is prohibited.

After a Core route has been registered or a copy printed, page_purpose, purpose_detail, template_identity, capture_mode, entry_layout, and exact existing context are historical semantics and must not be materially rewritten in place; correction requires preserved history and, where necessary, a new Page Target/route.

Any existing_work_context or existing_record_context must resolve exactly, remain in the legitimate class/work history, and must never silently follow migration, supersession, ownership correction, plan adaptation, or cross-year succession; if both contexts are present, their exact work references must agree.

The application must enforce semantic compatibility between page_purpose and any exact existing context; purpose describes intended capture context only and never proves that the corresponding domain fact occurred or is true.

Creating or printing a Page Target must not pre-create Event, participant, Account, Observation, Review, Classification, Hypothesis, Determination, Response, Communication, Support Process/Participant, Need, Goal, Support, Intervention, Implementation, Fidelity, Follow-Up, Outcome, Reentry, or Repair facts solely to satisfy routing or printing.
QR/PDS2 locator and human fallback text must remain privacy-minimized; sensitive narrative and domain conclusions belong neither in route payloads nor in Portia Page Target identity fields.

work_id.description: Owning Capture Batch identity and the same work_id carried by Core work references for this capture workflow. Existing Event/Support Process context, when any, is represented separately and exactly.

page_index.description: Positive logical page position inside the capture rendering workflow. It is not the historical template page ordinal, a retained-source page number, or a printed-copy identity.

page_purpose.description: Closed descriptive intent for the page. Purpose never establishes that an Event, implementation, fidelity result, follow-up, reentry, repair, or other domain fact exists or occurred.

purpose_detail.description: Bounded explanatory detail required exactly when page_purpose is other.

capture_mode.description: Expected mechanical interpretation mode for this historical layout. It controls processing expectations only and never authorizes semantic inference or review bypass.

existing_work_context.description: Optional exact historical Event or Support Process context known at print time. This is separate from the Capture Batch work_id and must not silently follow later successors or corrections.

existing_record_context.description: Optional exact historical Portia child-record context when the page is specifically tied to a known record representation. Its contained exact work reference remains historical.

status.description: Operational Page Target state. retired prevents new use but does not erase historical meaning; invalidated marks the representation defective without erasing any Core route or retained-source history.

layout_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 digest/fingerprint of the exact historical interpretation layout/capture specification used for this page.

page_role.description: Stable template-local semantic page role, such as incident_form or monitoring_sheet; it is not a domain assertion.

page_ordinal.description: Positive ordinal of this page within the exact template/layout version. It is distinct from scan order and retained-source page number.

entry_keys.description: Stable template-local entry/slot keys. They identify reviewable page-local locations only; an entry key does not identify a person, Event, or canonical record and does not mean the slot contains returned content.
